projects.title: LinkedIn Auto-Apply
projects.description:
A hackathon project for Hack Week 2026 @ LinkedIn. 
Together we built a full stack iOS proof of concept using LinkedIn's ecosystem that allows users to easily apply to jobs with just one swipe, similar to dating apps like Tinder. Upon swiping right, our autonomous agent applies to jobs for the user, using their experience to answer questions on the job application. The agent will also tailor the user's resume if needed for the specific job. This solution simplifies the job search process which can be overwhelming for many.

projects.title: Web5 Lightning Paywall
projects.description: A Web5-powered publishing app where creators post blog content and lock it behind a Lightning Network paywall. Readers unlock individual posts (or subscribe) with instant, low-fee Bitcoin payments.
